text:
sarah-marketing: Hey runtime team — need a focused rerun for launch collateral + webinar. Goal: show warmup vs steady-state behavior for our recommended quantized profile and fp16 baseline. Can you run a sanity sweep and produce a small CSV (p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/sec, and cost estimate) with these axes: model variant (fp16, int8), warmup on vs off (prefix cache), and short vs long seq lengths. Target: quick smoke by EOD today, full 10k-token steady run by EOD Wed. Sample payloads below.

kevin-runtime: Clarifying q's — which model name exactly? sequence lengths and batch sizes? Also do you want cold-start meaning new container for each request or cold KV cache only?

sarah-marketing: Use model name: rw-7b-instruct (the one listed in model-catalog). Sequence lengths: short=32 tokens, medium=256, long=1024. Batch sizes: 1 and 8. Cold-start = new process image (simulate container spin up) + cold KV cache. Warmup on = run 5 warmup prompts before measuring.

anya-eng: For simulation details I recommend: Poisson arrivals with mean interarrival to hit target RPS, mix 60% short / 30% medium / 10% long. Warmup pattern: send 5 unique prompts to populate KV cache, then run measurements. For cold-start, spin a fresh instance and measure the first 100 requests to capture startup. Sample payload (one per line):
```
{"prompt":"Summarize the following product release notes in 2 bullets:\n- Feature A\n- Feature B","max_tokens":128}
```
Also record per-request token counts so we can normalize cost.

infra-bot: bench-job queued: id=bench-1718000000-01 status=queued

kevin-runtime: We can do a smoke sweep now (small sample: 100 cold starts, 500 steady requests) and push full runs overnight. Output CSV fields: run_id, model_variant, quant_profile, warmup, seq_len, batch_size, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd. Anything else?

sarah-marketing: That CSV schema works. Please also include a short notes field for anomalies (OOMs, fallbacks to CPU, quantize-fallback). And attach the raw logs and a link to any perf dashboard. Here's the sample payloads GDrive: https://drive.redwood.example/marketing/bench-samples (internal). CC @sophie-sales to flag lead routing if we see >2s p99 on short queries.

sophie-sales: noted — if a customer query is in the sample or we see sustained p99>2s on short (32) at batch=1, ping me and ops to prioritize.

kevin-runtime: Starting smoke now. Will post bench job ids + a short summary when complete. If we hit any blockers (OOMs / kernel fallbacks) I'll call it out inline.

sarah-marketing: Perfect, thanks — we need a short paragraphable summary for demo slides: lean, comparable numbers and a clear explanation of warmup impact. :thumbsup:
